I am a computer science and math student working toward quantitative finance. My background is in machine learning, math and algorithms, and I am now applying those methods to markets and risk.

This site collects two things:

- **Projects**: things I have built, from an interactive financial dashboard with backtesting and risk metrics to work in deep learning and combinatorial optimization.
- **Notes**: shorter write ups of ideas, methods and results I discover while working on my thesis or different projects. Each note states the question, the method, the result and the limitations.

If you are here to gauge whether I can do quantitative work, the [Projects](projects.qmd) page is the fastest read, and the [Notes](blog/index.qmd) show how I think through a problem.
